title: Reliable MEP service
body: Plumbing, HVAC, electrical and mechanical work for commercial and residential buildings, performed by {{service}}. This is the foundation and nearly all of the revenue. Every other layer depends on doing it well.
evidence: Jobs completed. Callback rate. Response time.

title: Measured performance
body: A repair is finished when a reading says so. We are building the habit of logging pressure, flow, temperature and humidity before and after, so that comfort and reliability can be shown and compared.
evidence: Before and after readings on file. Published field notes.

title: Water systems under test
body: Two water devices are in development: an electrocoagulation wash-water recycler and a high-speed torsion and compression plate device. Neither is for sale. Both are being measured before anything is claimed.
evidence: Test logs. Instrumentation status. Results when they exist.

title: Closed-loop and extreme environments
body: The long-range target is a space that reuses its own water, holds its own climate and can be repaired by the people inside it. Remote sites come first. A Mars habitat is the hardest version of the same problem, so it is the filter we use to decide what to learn next.
evidence: Nothing to show yet. That is stated on purpose.
